افتعلا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَعَلَا (iftaʕalā) /if.ta.ʕa.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# اُفْتُعِلَا (uftuʕilā) /uf.tu.ʕi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# اِفْتَعِلَا (iftaʕilā) /if.ta.ʕi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
